subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal attachment Graph lookup run automatically when Bot Framework supplies only HTML, or should it require an explicit channels.msteams config flag?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the safe fix shape changes fallback behavior and may add configuration in a high-bar config surface; the two linked PRs represent different policy choices.

options.title: Prefer opt-in fallback
options.body: Use the config-gated approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 so existing mention-only messages keep current behavior unless operators enable the Graph lookup tradeoff.

options.title: Prefer automatic fallback
options.body: Use the broader channel fallback from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 and accept the extra Graph lookup and diagnostic-noise risk as default attachment behavior.

options.title: Hold for narrower detection
options.body: Keep both PRs pending until Teams activity metadata or another signal can distinguish real file uploads without a new config flag.

recommendation.title: Prefer opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Use the config-gated approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 so existing mention-only messages keep current behavior unless operators enable the Graph lookup tradeoff.
